data.name: Crowne Plaza Leon by IHG
data.address: Blvd. Manuel J. Clouthier : 245, Jardines del Campestre, 37128 León de los Aldama, Gto., Mexico
data.description:
This upmarket hotel is 2 km from Metropolitano Park and 7 km from the neoclassical León Cathedral.
Featuring classic wood furnishings, the relaxed rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and desks. Suites come with separate living rooms; some have kitchens. Room service is available.
Parking is free. Amenities include an airy 24-hour restaurant and a lobby cocktail bar. There's also an atrium indoor pool and a hot tub, as well as a gym.
